hellforged-mastodon.name: Hellforged Mastodon
hellforged-mastodon.transport:
This unit can transport friendly <LEGION> models in one of the following combinations:
-- Up to 40 INFANTRY models.
-- Up to 30 INFANTRY models and 1 CHAOS DECIMATOR or HELBRUTE model.
-- Up to 20 INFANTRY models and up to 2 CHAOS DECIMATOR or HELBRUTE models.
Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

hellforged-dreadclaw-drop-pod.name: Hellforged Dreadclaw Drop Pod
hellforged-dreadclaw-drop-pod.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models, or 1 friendly CHAOS DECIMATOR model, or 1 friendly HELBRUTE model. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

hellforged-kharybdis-assault-claw.name: Hellforged Kharybdis Assault Claw
hellforged-kharybdis-assault-claw.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models, or up to 3 friendly <LEGION> HELLFORGED RAPIER units or 1 friendly CHAOS DECIMATOR model, or 1 friendly HELBRUTE model. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

hellforged-land-raider-achilles.name: Hellforged Land Raider Achilles
hellforged-land-raider-achilles.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models. If this model has an Accursed Phylactery, it can only transport up to 6 models.

hellforged-land-raider-proteus.name: Hellforged Land Raider Proteus
hellforged-land-raider-proteus.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models. If this model has an Accursed Phylactery, it can only transport up to 6 models.

hellforged-spartan-assault-tank.name: Hellforged Spartan Assault Tank
hellforged-spartan-assault-tank.transport: This unit can transport up to 25 friendly LEGION INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

chaos-sokar-pattern-stormbird-gunship.name: Chaos Sokar Pattern Stormbird Gunship
chaos-sokar-pattern-stormbird-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 50 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY, BIKER and CAVALRY models, or up to 25 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY, BIKER and CAVALRY  models and 1 friendly CHAOS RHINO. Each BIKER or CAVALRY model tales the space of 3 INFANTRY models, each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 otherINFANTRY models. A CHAOS RHINO can transport models whilst it is embarked aboard this unit.

chaos-storm-eagle-assault-gunship.name: Chaos Storm Eagle Assault Gunship
chaos-storm-eagle-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly LEGION INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

chaos-thunderhawk-assault-gunship.name: Chaos Thunderhawk Assault Gunship
chaos-thunderhawk-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 30 friendly LEGION INFANTRY, BIKER or CAVALRY models. Each BIKER or CAVALRY model tales the space of 3 INFANTRY models, each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

options.name: Bolt Pistols and Chosen Combat Weapons

chaos-rhino.name: Chaos Rhino
chaos-rhino.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly DEATH GUARD INFANTRY models. It cannot transport TERMINATORS or JUMP PACK units.

terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.name: Terrax-Pattern Termite Assault Drill
terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.transport: This unit can transport 12 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, TERMINATOR or CULT OF DESTRUCTION models.

chaos-land-raider.name: Chaos Land Raider
chaos-land-raider.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of two other models.

profiles.name: Chaos Lord on Disc of Tzeentch

lord-of-chaos.name: Lord of Chaos
lord-of-chaos.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <LEGION> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

lord-of-the-skulltakers.name: Lord of the Skulltakers
lord-of-the-skulltakers.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SKULLTAKERS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

lord-of-the-faithless.name: Lord of the Faithless
lord-of-the-faithless.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly THE FAITHLESS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

monstrous-bulk.name: Monstrous Bulk
monstrous-bulk.text: If this unit has a Dark Abeyant, it takes the space of 3 other Infantry models when embarked aboard a Transport.

warp-sighted-butcher.name: Warp-sighted Butcher
warp-sighted-butcher.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

aura-of-discord.name: Aura of Discord
aura-of-discord.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy VEHICLE units whilst they are within 6" of any units from your army with this ability. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by <LEGION> DAEMON ENGINE units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly <LEGION> units with this ability.

psychic-backlash.name: Psychic Backlash
psychic-backlash.text: When your opponent selects a unit within 12" of any units from your army with this ability to manifest a psychic power, before its effects are resolved roll one D12; if the result is equal to or greater than the Leadership characteristic of the unit manifesting the power, place one blast marker next to it. You cannot use both this ability and the Perils of the Warp Command Asset in reaction to the same psychic power.

lord-of-the-black-legion.name: Lord of the Black Legion
lord-of-the-black-legion.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly BLACK LEGION units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

mark-of-chaos-ascendant.name: Mark of Chaos Ascendant
mark-of-chaos-ascendant.text: Morale tests taken for friendly HERETIC ASTARTES units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

dark-destiny.name: Dark Destiny
dark-destiny.text: Roll D12s when making saving throws for this unit, irrespective of the size of the blast markers next to it.

headtaker.name: Headtaker
headtaker.text: Add 2 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

lord-of-the-raptors.name: Lord of the Raptors
lord-of-the-raptors.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly RAPTOR units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

might-over-magic.name: Might over Magic
might-over-magic.text: If this unit has the KHORNE keyword, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit.

dark-zealotry.name: Dark Zealotry
dark-zealotry.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly <Legion> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. For each Dark Disciple model this unit contains, the range of this ability is increased by 2".

demagogue.name: Demagogue
demagogue.text: Friendly <LEGION> units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit. For each Dark Disciple model this unit contains, the range of this ability is increased by 2".

aspire-to-glory.name: Aspire to Glory
aspire-to-glory.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly <LEGION> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

enhanced-warriors.name: Enhanced Warriors
enhanced-warriors.text:
At the start of the Action phase, you can choose one friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (but not CHARACTER) unit within 1" of this unit. Improve that unit’s Attacks
characteristic by 1 for the rest of the game. A unit can only be enhanced once per battle.

another-pair-of-hands.name: Another Pair of Hands
another-pair-of-hands.text: When using the Enhanced Warriors Ability, if Fabius Bile is accompanied by a Surgeon Acolyte, you can choose to grant the affected unit Ignore Damage (6+) instead of improving that unit's Attacks characteristic. The unit can still only be enhanced once per battle, regardless of which enhancement is chosen.

the-tyrant-of-badab.name: The Tyrant of Badab
the-tyrant-of-badab.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if this unit is a Warlord and is on the battlefield, you generate one extra Command Asset.

lord-of-the-red-corsairs.name: Lord of the Red Corsairs
lord-of-the-red-corsairs.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly RED CORSAIR units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

champions-of-the-host.name: Champions of the Host
champions-of-the-host.text: Each Elites slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to two of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Elites slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

locus-of-power.name: Locus of Power
locus-of-power.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by <LEGION> DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of any units with this ability.

unending-rage.name: Unending Rage
unending-rage.text: Whilst this unit has any damage markers next to it, add 1 to its Attacks characteristic for each of those markers.

loathsome-aura.name: Loathsome Aura
loathsome-aura.text: Improve the Save characteristic (to a maximum of 4+) of friendly LIGHT CHAOS units by 1 whilst they are within 18" of any units with this ability.

lord-of-slaanesh.name: Lord of Slaanesh
lord-of-slaanesh.text: Re-roll hit roll of 1 for attacks made by friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

armour-of-shrieking-souls.name: Armour of Shrieking Souls
armour-of-shrieking-souls.text: At the beginning of the Damage phase, if this unit has any blast markers next to it, roll one D12; on a 5+ you can place one blast marker next to one unit in base contact with this unit. If you do, remove one blast marker from this unit.

the-betrayer.name: The Betrayer
the-betrayer.text: You cannot re-roll or modify unmodified hit rolls of 1 made for this unit’s attacks. If an unmodified hit roll of 1 is made for an attack by this unit and there are any other friendly units within 1" of it, select one of those units; place one blast marker next to the selected unit.

kill-maim-burn.name: Kill! Maim! Burn!
kill-maim-burn.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for friendly WORLD EATERS units when using melee weapons whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

steed-of-slaanesh.name: Steed of Slaanesh
steed-of-slaanesh.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by a unit with a Steed of Slaanesh.

lord-of-chaos-2.name: Lord of Chaos
lord-of-chaos-2.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly BLACK LEGION and friendly SERVANTS OF THE ABYSS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

aura-of-dark-majesty.name: Aura of Dark Majesty
aura-of-dark-majesty.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons by enemy units that target this unit.

arch-villain.name: Arch-villain
arch-villain.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if this unit is a WARLORD and is on the battlefield, you generate one extra Command Asset.

master-of-mechanisms.name: Master of Mechanisms
master-of-mechanisms.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly <LEGION> VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

gift-of-the-hellforge.name: Gift of the Hellforge
gift-of-the-hellforge.text: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly HELLFORGED units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

slaves-to-mallex.name: Slaves to Mallex
slaves-to-mallex.text: This unit does not take up slots in a Detachment that contains OBSIDIUS MALLEX.
